text: BAM share fell 0.06 percentage points over 25 hours, but remains up 1.65 percentage points over 7 days at 37.4% of Solana stake. Concentration remains elevated: ams-mainnet-bam-2-tee holds 24.7% of BAM stake, and the node Nakamoto coefficient is 3. The 66 top-node leadership changes are best read as whale-driven routing, not structural rollover; only the fra rollover on 2026-06-24 has been validated.
